Sam / Aisha —

Thanks — quick technical clarifications from the Redwood infra side so the ops handoff is frictionless: 
1) VPC peering specifics: we prefer peering with route propagation disabled and explicit route table entries on both sides. When you raise the peering request please include the VPC ID + VPC CIDR and the intended subnet(s) for POC nodes. Example: vpc-0abc1234 / 10.40.0.0/16. We will provide the Redwood peering ID (rwd-peering-xxxx) once we accept.

2) IP allowlist: Redwood will provide the list of public endpoints used by the POC (API endpoints and control-plane IPs). If you can share the NAT egress ranges, Ben will insert them into our staging allowlists.

3) SSO / SAML: we typically support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows; for the fastest test, SP-initiated with test user is easiest. Sam — please share IdP metadata (XML) or the raw ACS URL + issuer. I attached our sample SP metadata here for your IdP admin to copy. If you want, we can temporarily create a test SP with a short-lived test certificate to speed validation.

4) Secrets / KMS: if you choose customer-managed KMS, we'll need the key ARN and a service account with kms:Decrypt permission scoped to the key. If you prefer Redwood-managed, we'll provide a secure ingestion endpoint and a short key-rotation plan. Laura — I left a placeholder in the MAP spreadsheet for the permissions template.

I will join the tech-check at 10:30 PT. After that call, we can mark the VPC peering and SSO tasks as "in progress" in the MAP and adjust dates if needed.

-Karthik
